description: Rotate pages by a multiple of 90 degrees. Omit `pages` to rotate every page. Runs entirely on this machine — the file is read and written locally and never sent anywhere.

angle.description: Rotation in degrees; must be a multiple of 90 (e.g. 90, 180, -90)

force.description: Replace the output file if it already exists (default: refuse, so existing files are never silently clobbered)

output.description: Path to write the rotated PDF

name: pdf_rotate
title: Rotate PDF pages
